candidates.decision: When a new interface advertises Supported-Features/Feature-List for the first time and has no interface-specific bit mapping yet, default the Feature-List value to 0x00000001 (baseline/Rel-8 support bit), matching the value Gx's own Feature-List-ID 1 already advertises, rather than 0 (no bits set).
candidates.reasoning: 0x00000001 as a baseline-support bit is the existing repo convention for a first Feature-List-ID entry (Gx sets Feature-List-ID 1; S6a sets Feature-List-ID 1 and 2) — advertising 0 communicates 'no features supported at all', which is a materially different (and likely wrong) signal to send to a peer during initial feature negotiation.
rejected_alternatives: Default new interfaces' first Feature-List value to 0 until the exact bit-to-feature mapping is confirmed

candidates.decision: New Diameter AVP-construction blocks guarded by cc_request_type in SMF Gx/Gy paths must skip on OGS_DIAM_GY_CC_REQUEST_TYPE_TERMINATION_REQUEST (or the Gx equivalent) — a Termination-Request needs no feature/QoS renegotiation AVPs.
candidates.reasoning: Established by the existing Gx Supported-Features block (gx-path.c:322), which already guards this way; keeping new interfaces consistent avoids sending renegotiation AVPs on a request whose only purpose is tearing the session down.
rejected_alternatives: Send Supported-Features unconditionally on every CCR regardless of request type

candidates.decision: Diameter AVP dictionary handles (dict_object*) for AVPs already declared for one interface in this codebase (e.g. Feature-List-ID, Feature-List — generic 3GPP AVPs shared across Gx/Gy/S6a) must not be re-declared per-interface; a new interface adding a feature that needs an already-declared AVP only needs to add the missing handle(s), not redeclare the ones that already exist.
candidates.reasoning: Redeclaring an already-defined global dict_object* pointer under the same name causes a duplicate-symbol link error; this codebase's existing message.c files already share several generic AVP handles this way (checked: Feature-List-ID/Feature-List exist for both Gx and Gy today, defined once each, not duplicated).
rejected_alternatives: Each interface's message.c declares and resolves its own copy of every AVP handle it uses, even ones shared with other interfaces
